title: See the cost before every paid start
summary: See the cost before every paid start, InDesign translation, a new Cosmos builder with an assistant, and per-rule style guides.

sections.title: See the cost before you start
sections.note: Every paid action shows its credit cost before it starts.

items.body: Credits are taken at the start and refunded if a job fails
Not enough credits? A **Top up** link shows instead
Credit Activity is easier to read

sections.title: InDesign translation
sections.note: Translate .idml files in Playground. Styles, layout and images stay as they were.

items.body: Complex scripts like Hindi and Arabic render correctly
Preview the layout, with a red box where text doesn't fit

sections.title: Cosmos: new builder and workflow assistant

items.body: A faster builder with undo, copy and paste, and templates
Describe a workflow and the assistant builds it
A filterable runs list and a live run page
Style guides: rules apply to several languages and can be turned off
Folders: a process shows its input file in its folder
Translate Video: uploads keep their frame rate and quality
Generate All and bulk emotion in Translate Video are free
Translate Video runs from Cosmos or Assets read the file length
The Translation Memory page shows the right number of rows
A failed image translation stops its spinner
